goal: Build and evaluate a transparent evidence-backed CGKN Project Digital Persona with durable identity, episodic references, relationships, commitments, bounded reflection, situation awareness, and precision-first attention.
acceptance_criteria: Identity Constitution remains immutable without a governed amendment and public affiliation remains transparent
episode, relationship, commitment, reflection, and SelfModel updates require real evidence references
Situation and precision-first Attention correctly choose action, silence, follow-up, commitment fulfillment, or human review
localized Persona context reduces context by at least 40% without identity, relationship, or behavior regression
a frozen 100-episode P0/P1/P2/P3 benchmark demonstrates durable continuity without hallucination or severe drift
Community and Promotion approval boundaries remain unchanged and no unapproved external write occurs
formal evaluation runs from one clean Source Closure and full repository regression passes

quality_metrics.measure: relationship, commitment, attention, disclosure, and outsider correctness

improvement: remove Persona layers if P3 adds no benefit over P2

interface_expectations: CapabilityRegistry remains the sole capability authority
Persona is an application capability branch, not a new Knowledge, retrieval, planning, runtime, DAG, or project-state authority
Persona state stores evidence references and derived continuity, never duplicate project facts
Community remains discovery, policy, reply transport, and follow-up authority
Promotion remains claim, approval, and publication authority
public writes remain exact-approval guarded and production routing remains fixed

experiments: compare P0/P1/P2/P3 before retaining all Persona layers
